# Saabai

> Saabai (ABN 71 889 082 572) is a Gold Coast, Queensland business (Merrimac QLD 4226, Australia) founded by Shane Goldberg. All prices are in AUD. Saabai is not GST registered (GST not applicable).

## Products

- [Website care plans](https://www.saabai.ai/websites): Saabai builds, hosts and manages small business websites with an AI enquiry chatbot built in. Care plans: Presence $100/month, Growth $200/month, Signature $300/month. Builds start from $2,000.
- [Saabai Blueprint AI audit](https://www.saabai.ai/blueprint): a ranked AI plan showing where AI saves hours and dollars. Starter $497 (within 48 hours), Pro $1,497 (3 business days, reviewed by Shane, 30 min walkthrough), Business $3,500 (2 to 3 weeks, team discovery, 12 month roadmap). Fee credited if you build with Saabai within 30 days.
- [Free AI Readiness Score](https://www.saabai.ai/score): a free 3 minute, 12 question quiz with an instant score out of 100 and three quick wins.
- [Lex](https://www.saabai.ai/legal): an AI legal assistant for Australian law firms. It cites ATO rulings and Commonwealth legislation. The Firm plan is $299 a month.
- [Custom AI chatbots](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-developer-queensland): custom AI chatbots for Queensland business websites. A website chatbot is included in the care plans above. A custom build is quoted on a call.
- [Custom AI agents](https://www.saabai.ai/custom-ai-agents): agents that answer questions. Quoting and follow-up are custom work, quoted to the job. Book a call for a quote.
- [AI chatbot for law firms](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-law-firms): custom AI chatbots for Australian law firms, plus Lex. The chatbot answers after-hours enquiries and keeps a log of the chat. Enquiry alerts are coming soon.
- [AI receptionist for Gold Coast businesses](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-receptionist-gold-coast): a website chatbot for Gold Coast businesses. Included in the website tiers, from $2,000 plus $100 a month care. Answers enquiries 24/7 and keeps a log of each chat. Enquiry alerts are coming soon.
- [SEO and AI search visibility](https://www.saabai.ai/seo-ai-search): included in every Blueprint, from $497. Checks Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini.
- [LeadGen](https://www.saabai.ai/leadgen): AI lead capture for service businesses. Starter $197/month, Pro $397/month, Enterprise $997/month.
- [Pricing](https://www.saabai.ai/pricing): the published prices collected on one page.

## FAQ

**We're not a tech company. Is AI automation actually for us?**
This is almost exclusively for non-tech businesses. Tradies, clinics, studios, agencies, retailers and local service businesses across Australia. These are exactly who we work with. Your team doesn't need to understand how any of it works. You just get the time back.

**How long does it take to get AI automation live?**
Simple automations can go live in one to two weeks. More complex multi-system workflows typically take four to six weeks from design to deployment.

**Will AI automation work with our existing software tools?**
Almost certainly yes. We build on top of the tools you already have: your CRM, email platform, practice management software, calendar, documents. You shouldn't have to rip anything out.

**How much does AI automation typically cost?**
A Saabai Blueprint is optional. It is a fixed-price plan: Starter $497, Pro $1,497 or Business $3,500. Website care plans are sold on their own, from $2,000 plus $100 a month. If you book a build within 30 days of receiving the Blueprint, the fee comes off that build invoice. The credit does not cover care plans or monthly fees. Custom work is quoted to the job. The free AI Readiness Score takes about 3 minutes.

**Is the strategy call really free?**
Yes, genuinely free. No invoice, no follow-up pressure, no free call that turns into a two-hour pitch. We only take it if we think there's a real opportunity to help. If your operation isn't a good fit, we'll tell you on the call.

**We tried automation before and it didn't stick. Why would this be different?**
Usually because the previous attempt was a generic off-the-shelf tool not designed around how your business actually operates. We build custom systems and stay involved post-launch. Ongoing maintenance is part of the deal, not an afterthought.

**I run a trade or local service business. What does AI actually do for us?**
Usually a website that answers enquiries and keeps a log of the chat after hours. Quoting from your own price list is custom work, scoped and quoted, not part of the website plans. Follow-up and invoice reminders are quoted separately. Most tradies and service businesses start with a website care plan from $100 a month or a Saabai Blueprint from $497.

**What about privacy and data security?**
We design with data handling in mind from the start and only connect the tools you approve. Your requirements are discussed upfront and the setup is built around them. Most of what we automate is enquiries, follow-up and scheduling, not sensitive records.
